snippet.title: SUPERPANEL - DEMO RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Play DEMO on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/3876140/SUPERPANEL_Demo/
SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.
